latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of liblib-ai-gen.

- Enables image generation using Seedream4.5 via the LiblibAI API.
- Supports video generation (text-to-video and image-to-video) with Kling models.
- Provides CLI with options for prompt, model, image size, reference images, and video duration.
- Includes async task handling with status polling.
- Requires LIB_ACCESS_KEY and LIB_SECRET_KEY environment variables for API access.
